entities.name: Charlotte Maria Tucker
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charlotte Maria Tucker was a prolific English writer and poet for children and adults, who wrote under the pseudonym A.L.O.E.. Late in life she spent a period as a volunteer missionary in India, where she died.
